The '''Coruscant Amusement Center''' was a facility that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] and [[Jarid DeBell]] took their daughter, [[Night Forael Wren|Night Wren]], to the Coruscant Amusement Center and while there, they had a [[Holopic/Legends|holopic]] taken of Night playing in a zero-[[Gravity/Legends|g]] ball room. Lavina and DeBell later promised Night that they would take her to the center again for her birthday, but they were unable to do so, because Night was kidnapped by the [[Thaereian military]].
